ValidationRule.description: Request from sales ops to hide the opportunity types that will not be used by NA at Go Live. Amendments, upsells, etc will not be used.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( AND( OR( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = 'Opportunity', $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = '' ), NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c) ), AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CPQ_Sales_Opportunity', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal')), OR(Billing_Country__r.Name = 'Canada',Billing_Country__r.Name = 'United States') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity can be created only for Type - New Deal
